segments.ja291:1.3: Yāva naṃ anupāleti, tāva so sukhamedhati.
segments.ja291:2.1: Yadā matto ca ditto ca, pamādā kumbhamabbhidā;
segments.ja291:2.3: Tadā naggo ca pottho ca, pacchā bālo vihaññati.
segments.ja291:3.1: Evameva yo dhanaṃ laddhā, pamatto [amattā (sī.), amatto (pī.)] paribhuñjati;
segments.ja291:3.3: Pacchā tappati dummedho, kuṭaṃ bhitvāva [kuṭaṃ bhinnova (sī. pī.), kuṭabhinnova (?)] dhuttakoti.

lines: Tattha sabbakāmadadanti sabbe vatthukāme dātuṃ samatthaṃ kumbhaṃ.
Anupāletīti yo koci evarūpaṃ labhitvā yāva rakkhati, tāva so sukhamedhatīti attho.
Matto ca ditto cāti surāmadena matto dappena ditto.
Naggo ca pottho cāti kadāci naggo, kadāci potthakapilotikāya nivatthattā pottho.
